sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Vehicle Inspection and Registration

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A01
Inspections repeat every year, yet each passing report only counts ninety days from its inspection month toward registration [A01].
Why it matters: group inspection-timing; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F01, sec02-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A01
Modern cars carry two taillights and two brake lights, while pre-nineteen-sixty cars need only one of each [A01].
Why it matters: group lighting; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A01
Reflectors sit fifteen to sixty inches high and show six hundred feet out, except pre-nineteen-sixty cars whose reflectors show three hundred fifty feet [A01].
Why it matters: group lighting; difficulty medium; prereq sec02-F04; confusables sec02-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A01
Both the horn and the rearview mirror share a two-hundred-foot standard, the horn heard that far and the mirror seeing that far behind [A01].
Why it matters: group equipment; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0021]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A02
Loads may poke three inches past the left side but six inches past the right, and front red lights stay banned for everyone except emergency vehicles [A02].
Why it matters: group banned-gear; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A02
Spotlights switch off for oncoming drivers, yet may light fifty feet of road when the headlights themselves fail [A02].
Why it matters: group optional-gear; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A02
Fresh purchases must register within thirty days, while buyer temporary tags remain good sixty days [A02].
Why it matters: group registration-timing; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A03
Light farm trailers at four thousand pounds or less run fully exempt, while heavier farm trailers to thirty-four thousand pounds need the annual five-dollar plate [A03].
Why it matters: group exemptions; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec02-F10, sec02-F11 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A03
New residents register everything before licensing, while newcomers who just arrived or just started work get thirty days of driving first [A03].
Why it matters: group residency; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec02-F12 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-tx-c:texas-department-of-public-safety-driver:handbook:pdf-0023]

ranked.label: Timing pairs: yearly versus ninety days, thirty versus sixty
